questions.stem:
将下列句子译成汉语：
The book that you lent me last week is very interesting, and I have read it twice.
questions.answer: 你上周借给我的那本书很有意思，我已经读了两遍。
points: 定语从句 that you lent me last week 前置，译成“你上周借给我的（那本书）”
is very interesting 译为“很有意思 / 很有趣”
have read it twice 译为“已经读了两遍”，译出完成时的“已经”
译文通顺，没有漏译
questions.explain: 较短的定语从句通常译成“……的”放在名词前面；现在完成时 have read 要译出“已经”。
questions.verify: 据了解，真题第七部分“英译汉”是把一篇短文中划线的 5 个句子译成汉语，共 15 分；请对照最近的真题核对形式与分值。

questions.stem:
将下列句子译成汉语：
If I had known about the meeting earlier, I would have attended it.
questions.answer: 要是我早点知道这个会，我就去参加了。
points: 虚拟条件句译成“要是（如果）……，就……了”，体现与过去事实相反
had known about the meeting earlier 译为“早点知道这个会（会议）”
would have attended it 译为“就去参加了 / 就会参加了”
questions.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，译成“要是……，就……了”，能让读者明白实际上“并不知道、也没参加”。

questions.stem:
将下列句子译成汉语：
Not until he lost his job did he realize the importance of education.
questions.answer: 直到失去了工作，他才意识到教育的重要性。
points: Not until…did… 倒装结构译为“直到……才……”
lost his job 译为“失去工作 / 丢了工作”
realize the importance of education 译为“意识到教育的重要性”
questions.explain: Not until… 放在句首时主句倒装（did he realize），整句译成“直到……才……”，不要按字面译成“不直到”。

questions.kp: 英译汉：非限制性定语从句
questions.stem:
将下列句子译成汉语：
The new bridge, which was completed last year, has greatly shortened the travel time between the two cities.
questions.answer: 这座新桥于去年建成，大大缩短了两座城市之间的通行时间。
points: 非限制性定语从句拆开译成分句：“（这座新桥）于去年建成 / 竣工”
has greatly shortened 译为“大大缩短了”
the travel time between the two cities 译为“两座城市之间的通行（路上）时间”
questions.explain: 非限制性定语从句可以单独译成一个分句，放在主语后面；greatly 修饰动词，译为“大大地”。

questions.kp: 英译汉：It is believed that 句型
questions.stem:
将下列句子译成汉语：
It is generally believed that regular exercise can help people stay healthy.
questions.answer: 人们普遍认为，经常锻炼可以帮助人们保持健康。
points: It is generally believed that… 译为“人们普遍认为……”，不译出 it
regular exercise 译为“经常（有规律的）锻炼”
help people stay healthy 译为“帮助人们保持健康”
questions.explain: It is believed / said / reported that… 一类句型，通常译成“人们认为 / 据说 / 据报道……”，不要译成“它被认为”。

questions.stem:
将下列句子译成汉语：
Having finished her homework, the girl went out to play with her friends.
questions.answer: 做完作业后，那个女孩出去和朋友们玩了。
points: Having finished her homework 译为“做完作业后”，体现动作先后
went out to play with her friends 译为“出去和朋友们玩”
语序符合汉语习惯，不用“她已经完成了她的作业”这样的直译
questions.explain: 完成式分词 Having done 作状语，表示这个动作在主句动作之前完成，一般译成“……之后”。

lessons.title: 英译汉：短文中的划线句

questions.passage:
Volunteering

Every weekend, thousands of young people in our city give up their free time to help others. (1) Some of them visit old people who live alone, while others teach children from poor families to read. Why do they do it?

For many volunteers, the answer is simple. (2) Helping others makes them feel that their lives are meaningful. Others say that volunteering has taught them skills they could never learn in a classroom, such as how to work in a team and how to solve problems.

(3) Volunteering is also a good way to make friends with people who share the same values. Many volunteers say that their closest friends are people they met while working on a project together.

Of course, volunteering takes time and energy. (4) Experts advise young people to choose an activity that they are really interested in, so that they will not give up halfway. (5) As long as you are willing to help, there is always something you can do for others.
questions.stem:
将短文中标 (1) 的句子译成汉语：
Some of them visit old people who live alone, while others teach children from poor families to read.
questions.answer: 他们当中有些人去看望独居老人，另一些人则教贫困家庭的孩子读书识字。
points: Some…, while others… 译为“有些人……，另一些人则……”
old people who live alone 译为“独居老人”
teach children from poor families to read 译为“教贫困家庭的孩子读书识字”
questions.explain: Some…, while others… 是对比结构，while 译成“而 / 则”；定语从句 who live alone 很短，前置译成“独居的”。

questions.stem:
将短文中标 (2) 的句子译成汉语：
Helping others makes them feel that their lives are meaningful.
questions.answer: 帮助别人让他们觉得自己的生活很有意义。
points: 动名词短语 Helping others 作主语，译为“帮助别人”
make sb. feel that… 译为“让（使）某人觉得……”
their lives are meaningful 译为“自己的生活（人生）有意义”
questions.explain: 动名词短语作主语，直接译成“帮助别人”；make sb. feel… 译为“让某人感到……”，their 在这里译成“自己的”更自然。

questions.stem:
将短文中标 (3) 的句子译成汉语：
Volunteering is also a good way to make friends with people who share the same values.
questions.answer: 做志愿者也是结交志同道合的朋友的好办法。
points: Volunteering 作主语，译为“做志愿者 / 志愿服务”
a good way to do sth. 译为“做某事的好办法（好途径）”
make friends with people who share the same values 译为“结交价值观相同（志同道合）的朋友”
questions.explain: 不定式 to make friends… 作 way 的定语，译成“……的好办法”；share the same values 可以意译为“志同道合”。

questions.kp: 英译汉：长句（定语从句 + 目的状语从句）
questions.passage:

For many volunteers, the answer is simple. (2) Helping others makes them feel that their lives are meaningful. Others say that volunteering has taught them skills they could never learn in a classroom, such as how to work in a team and how to solve problems.

(3) Volunteering is also a good way to make friends with people who share the same values. Many volunteers say that their closest friends are people they met while working on a project together.

Of course, volunteering takes time and energy. (4) Experts advise young people to choose an activity that they are really interested in, so that they will not give up halfway. (5) As long as you are willing to help, there is always something you can do for others.
questions.stem:
将短文中标 (4) 的句子译成汉语：
Experts advise young people to choose an activity that they are really interested in, so that they will not give up halfway.
questions.answer: 专家建议年轻人选择自己真正感兴趣的活动，这样就不会半途而废。
points: advise sb. to do sth. 译为“建议某人做某事”
定语从句前置：“自己真正感兴趣的活动”
so that… 译为“这样（以便）……”
give up halfway 译为“半途而废 / 中途放弃”
questions.explain: 长句先找主干 Experts advise young people to choose an activity，再把定语从句前置译成“……的”，so that 引导的目的状语从句放在句末。

questions.stem:
将短文中标 (5) 的句子译成汉语：
As long as you are willing to help, there is always something you can do for others.
questions.answer: 只要你愿意帮忙，总有你能为别人做的事情。
points: As long as 译为“只要”
be willing to help 译为“愿意帮忙（帮助别人）”
there is always something you can do for others 译为“总有你能为别人做的事情”
questions.explain: As long as 引导条件状语从句，译成“只要……”；something you can do for others 省略了关系代词 that，定语前置译成“你能为别人做的事”。

questions.stem:
写作：假设你是李明，你的英国朋友 Tom 打算来中国学汉语，来信征求你的建议。请用英语给他回一封信，内容包括：
1. 欢迎他来中国；
2. 至少提两条学好汉语的建议；
3. 表示愿意提供帮助。
词数 80～100。
questions.answer:
Dear Tom,

I am very glad to hear that you are coming to China to study Chinese. Welcome!

Here are some suggestions. First, try to speak Chinese as much as possible, and don't be afraid of making mistakes. Second, watch Chinese TV programs and listen to Chinese songs. They will help you improve your listening and learn how people really talk. Third, learn a few Chinese characters every day and review them often.

If you need any help, just let me know. I would be happy to meet you at the airport and show you around the city.

Best wishes,
Li Ming
points: 格式：称呼、正文、结束语和署名齐全
要点 1：欢迎 Tom 来中国
要点 2：至少两条学汉语的具体建议，用 First / Second 分条
要点 3：表示愿意提供帮助
语言：时态、拼写基本正确，句子通顺连贯
questions.explain: 书信写作先保证三个要点都写到，再用 First、Second、Third 分条写建议；Best wishes 后面另起一行署名。评分一般看要点是否齐全、语言是否准确连贯。
questions.verify: 据了解，真题最后一部分“写作”为 1 题、15 分，题材多为书信或短文；词数要求（本课按 80～100 词）请对照最近的真题核对。

questions.stem:
写作：以 Online Shopping 为题，用英语写一篇短文，内容包括：
1. 网上购物的好处；
2. 网上购物存在的问题；
3. 你的看法。
词数 80～100。
questions.answer:
Online Shopping

Online shopping has become part of our daily life, and it has many advantages. First, it is convenient. We can buy almost anything at any time without leaving home. Second, goods sold online are often cheaper, and it is easy to compare prices.

However, online shopping also has some problems. Sometimes the goods we receive are different from the pictures, and returning them takes time. Besides, some people spend too much money because buying things online is so easy.

In my opinion, online shopping is a good thing as long as we use it wisely. We should buy only what we really need and choose reliable shops.
points: 要点 1：网购的好处（至少两点，如方便、便宜）
要点 2：网购的问题（如货不对板、冲动消费）
要点 3：明确写出自己的看法
结构：三段式，用 First / However / In my opinion 衔接
语言：语法、拼写基本正确，没有中式表达
questions.explain: “好处 + 问题 + 看法”是常见的短文题型：第一段写好处，第二段用 However 转到问题，第三段用 In my opinion 表明态度。

questions.stem:
写作：以 My Favorite Teacher 为题，用英语写一篇短文，内容包括：
1. 这位老师是谁；
2. 他 / 她的特点和对你的帮助；
3. 你的感受。
词数 80～100。
questions.answer:
My Favorite Teacher

My favorite teacher is Ms. Wang, who taught me English in high school. She was not only patient but also full of energy. Her classes were never boring because she often used songs, games and stories to help us learn.

What I remember most is how she helped me. At first I was weak in English and afraid to speak in class. Ms. Wang encouraged me to read aloud every morning and corrected my mistakes kindly. Gradually, I became more confident, and my grades improved a lot.

I will always be grateful to her. She taught me that hard work and confidence can change a person.
points: 要点 1：交代老师是谁、教什么
要点 2：写出老师的特点，并用具体事例说明对你的帮助
要点 3：写出自己的感受（如感激）
时态：回忆过去的事用一般过去时，前后一致
会用 not only…but also、定语从句等句型，语言通顺
questions.explain: 写人的短文要有具体事例，不要只堆形容词；叙述过去的事情时注意统一用一般过去时，最后一段可以用一般现在时或将来时写感受。

questions.stem:
写作：假设你是王磊，请用英语给经理张先生（Mr. Zhang）写一封电子邮件请两天假，内容包括：
1. 请假的原因；
2. 请假的时间；
3. 请假期间的工作安排。
词数 80～100。
questions.answer:
Dear Mr. Zhang,

I am writing to ask for two days' leave next Thursday and Friday. My mother is going to have an operation in my hometown, and I need to take care of her.

I have finished the monthly report, and I will send it to you before I leave. Li Hua has agreed to handle my daily work while I am away. If anything urgent comes up, you can reach me by phone at any time.

I will be back at work the following Monday. Thank you for your understanding.

Yours sincerely,
Wang Lei
points: 开头点明写信目的：I am writing to ask for…
要点 1、2：请假原因和具体时间
要点 3：工作交接安排和联系方式
结尾致谢，称呼、结束语、署名格式正确
语气礼貌，用词正式
questions.explain: 请假、道歉、询问一类的应用文，第一句直接说明写信目的；写给上级要用正式、礼貌的语气，结尾用 Yours sincerely。

questions.stem:
写作：以 Studying in My Spare Time 为题，用英语写一篇短文，内容包括：
1. 你为什么利用业余时间学习；
2. 你的学习方法；
3. 你遇到的困难和解决办法。
词数 80～100。
questions.answer:
Studying in My Spare Time

I work for a company during the day and prepare for the self-study exams in my spare time. I want to get a bachelor's degree because it will help me in my career.

Since I do not have much free time, I make good use of every short break. I study on my phone on the subway, and I review new words for twenty minutes before I go to bed.

The biggest difficulty is staying motivated when I am tired after work. To deal with it, I set small goals for each week and reward myself when I reach them. Step by step, I am getting closer to my goal.
points: 要点 1：说明业余学习的原因
要点 2：写出具体的学习方法（至少一条）
要点 3：写出困难以及怎样解决
用 because、since、To deal with it 等把内容连接起来
以一般现在时为主，语法、拼写基本正确
questions.explain: 写个人经历时，每个要点写 2～3 句，用具体做法支撑；可以把学过的句型（since 表原因、不定式表目的）用进去。
